name: Combined ORB-SLAM + 3DGS
definition: Combines an existing frame-based tracking system (ORB-SLAM) with 3DGS mapping. ORB-SLAM recovers poses, and 3DGS is trained with poses and sensor depth of keyframes, equivalent to offline splatting.
summary: Combined ORB-SLAM + 3DGS decouples pose estimation from map optimization, using ORB-SLAM for robust tracking and 3DGS for offline splatting to achieve simultaneous localization and mapping.
